concepts.definition: Publisher's identifier for the IP right application (application.application_number, repeated as party_activity.application_number), as published. It identifies the application only in combination with the IP right type; it is not a business registration number, ABN or ACN, and does not identify the party or the business.
concepts.why_not_existing: No shortlisted concept covers an IP-office application number; ext.licence.number and ext.licence.related_licence_number are owned by licence and identify authorisations, and ext.entity.prior_registration_number is a legacy business registration number, so reuse would change owner and meaning.

concepts.definition: Publisher's classification of the kind of IP right the application seeks (application.ip_right_type, repeated as party_activity.ip_right_type), e.g. patent. It classifies the application, not the party or the business, and does not state that any right has been granted or is enforceable.
concepts.why_not_existing: No shortlisted concept classifies an IP right application; ext.licence.category and ext.licence.authorisation are owned by licence and describe an authorisation held by a business, so reuse would change owner and meaning.

concepts.definition: Publisher's sub-classification of the IP right application within its IP right type (application.ip_right_sub_type), e.g. standard_complete, innovation or provisional for patents. It describes the application's own category and does not imply grant, enforceability or a business attribute.
concepts.why_not_existing: No shortlisted concept expresses an application sub-type; ext.licence.category is a licence category owned by licence, so reuse would change owner and meaning.

reuse.dyn.party.party_kind: party_activity.party_type is a party classification only, matching the shortlisted owner and meaning; not used in this group's columns but retained as-is.
reuse.dyn.party.party_key: party_activity.party_id is the IP-office party key; unchanged.
reuse.dyn.party.abn_supplied: party_activity.abn is an unvalidated, often-blank party-record value; unchanged.
reuse.dyn.party.party_name: party_activity.party_name is a free-text, lower-cased party label; unchanged.
reuse.dyn.party_activity.role: party_activity.party_role is the specific role on the application; unchanged.
reuse.dyn.party_activity.role_category: party_activity.party_role_category is the broad role category; unchanged.
reuse.dyn.party.address_postcode: party_activity.post_code is a raw, mixed-format party address attribute; unchanged.
reuse.dyn.party.address_state: party_activity.state_code is a raw, lower-cased party address attribute; unchanged.
reuse.dyn.party.address_country: party_activity.country_code is a raw, often-blank party address attribute; unchanged.
reuse.dyn.party_activity.effective_from_date: party_activity.effective_from_date is the start of the party-role validity window; unchanged.
reuse.dyn.party_activity.effective_to_date: party_activity.effective_to_date is the end of the party-role validity window; unchanged.
reuse.dyn.party_activity.is_current: party_activity.is_current is the party-role currency flag; unchanged.
reuse.dyn.party_activity.is_founding: party_activity.is_founding is a party-role founding flag, not a business establishment date; unchanged.
